Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Dedicated GPU capacity — Orbit MAP intro

Hi Julian —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together a short Mutual Action Plan ("Orbit MAP") to align on milestones for the dedicated-capacity evaluation and contract close. Core items included: stakeholder roster, evaluation success criteria, throughput/latency targets, procurement steps and an initial timeline.

Quick highlights:
- Evaluation window: 2 weeks (pilot harness + 3 perf runs)
- Target throughput: 6k–9k tokens/sec (end-to-end, 8k baseline)
- P50 generation latency target: <= 120ms at 512 tokens
- Hardware: H100 preferred; fallback to A100 with quantization profile

Please confirm the internal NovusAI stakeholders and the procurement contact so we can lock dates. I attached the Orbit_MAP_v1 and a concise evaluation-checklist — review the "Success criteria" tab and call out any must-haves.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm roster and procurement contact (this thread)
2) We schedule a 45-minute MAP kickoff call (technical + procurement) — propose Nov 18 or Nov 19
3) Redwood spins up a dedicated GPU pool preview for the 2-week eval (no charge during pilot)

Attachments: Orbit_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), evaluation-checklist.pdf (test harness + sample prompts)

—
Olga Petrov

Julian —

Thanks for the specifics. A couple of notes from the runtime/engineering side:

- Hardware: H100 gives us the best latency/throughput at 16-bit/8-bit mixed kernels. If you must use A100 we can enable optimized kernels and a quantization profile; expect ~10–20% higher p50 latency.
- 1M-token throughput test: we can orchestrate staged runs across the dedicated pool. We'll use the workload generator in the evaluation-checklist. Please confirm the token mix (short prompts vs 2–3k token responses).
- KV cache warmup: to meet target p50 we recommend a short warm-up phase (10–15 mins) before recorded runs; we'll document the procedure in the MAP.
- Instrumentation: we will produce token-level cost breakdowns and per-route latency traces for the evaluation.

I can own the test harness setup and will post the harness config to the shared Drive link once we finalize the token mix.

On timing: Nov 18 morning PST works for my calendar as a 9:30–10:15am slot.

—Marcus
